C08-M07-L06-F1.title: Classifying a coverage gap by the first condition it fails
C08-M07-L06-F1.caption: Four questions in the order of the detection conditions decide whether a behaviour is a data-source, field or scope, logic or evidence gap, or covered.
C08-M07-L06-F1.alt: Decision graph, top to bottom. A slate box, Behaviour in the threat model, leads to a violet decision: Telemetry collected? No leads to a red box, Data-source gap (new telemetry: infrastructure owner). Yes leads to: Fields parsed, all hosts and hours? No leads to an orange box, Field or scope gap (fix the pipeline or rollout). Yes leads to: Rule looks for it? No leads to an orange box, Logic gap (write a rule: detection engineering). Yes leads to: Tested: known-bad and near miss? No leads to a slate box, Untested coverage (add tests, Lesson 4). Yes leads to a green box, Covered, with evidence.

nodes.label: Behaviour in the threat model

C08-M07-L06-F1.note: The first failed condition names the gap's owner and the kind of fix.

C08-M07-L06-F2.title: Banyan gap register, prioritised by threat
C08-M07-L06-F2.caption: Gaps found by querying the lab dataset, with their type, the threat each hides, any compensating detection and the resulting priority.
C08-M07-L06-F2.alt: Table with columns Gap, Type, Hides, Compensated? and Priority. Row 1, red: VPN session not traceable inside; data-source; valid-account use after R2; no; 1 high. Row 2, red: No process events after 06:14; scope; persistence, upload and log-clear actors; partly, by R3, R4, R5; 2 high, one fix closes many. Row 3, orange: No DNS or flow telemetry; data-source; DNS C2 (T1071.004), non-proxy exfiltration; no; 3 medium-high. Row 4, orange: No rule for .docm downloads; logic; delivery at 06:12; yes, R1 two minutes later; 4 medium, nearly free. Row 5, blue: R3 cannot see the group; field; Administrators vs other groups; partly, R3 fires on all; 5 medium. Row 6, slate: No rule for local 4625 failures; logic; guessing at the console; lockout policy where set; 6 low.
C08-M07-L06-F2.note: Ordering is this lesson's judgement for a fictional microfinance threat model; record the reasoning so it can be challenged.
